newsitem.title: USA: Command Security reaches deal with ISS.
newsitem.headline: Command Security reaches deal with ISS.

text.p: Command Security Corp said Tuesday it had reached an agreement in principle to resolve all pending issues with ISS International Service System Inc regarding its October 1993 acquisition of certain security guard assets.
Command Security said it had managed to reduce the amount it still owed ISS for the customer lists to $500,000 from $1 million.
It said it would pay ISS $100,000 immediately and the other $400,000 by January 31, 1997.
The lists are primarily of commercial customers who contract the company to provide security guards.

"This agreement will have a positive impact on our balance sheet by immediately reducing our short-term debt by $500,000 and Intangible Assets by $500,000," it said. "This will result in a reduction of more than $100,000 per year in amortization expense for the next four years."
